papers.title: Restorative resection in robot-assisted versus laparoscopic total mesorectal excision: systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Genders C, Wentink J, Geitenbeek R, Hompes R, van Praagh J, Consten E
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The surgical treatment of rectal cancer is based on the principle of total mesorectal excision (TME). Owing to its technological advantages, robot-assisted total mesorectal excision (R-TME) is hypothesized to facilitate primary anastomosis more frequently than laparoscopic total mesorectal excision (L-TME). This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to investigate whether R-TME is associated with a higher likelihood of restorative surgery compared with L-TME.
METHODS: This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines. The protocol was prospectively registered in PROSPERO, the international prospective register of systematic reviews (registration number: 1106767). PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, the Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched for studies from January 2010 to January 2026. Pooled ORs and mean differences were calculated using a random-effects model.
RESULTS: Twenty studies were included, reporting on 7133 patients. The pooled analysis demonstrated a significantly higher likelihood of restorative surgery with R-TME compared with L-TME (OR 1.43 (95% c.i. 1.04 to 1.98)). In a subgroup analysis of studies including patients after 2020, a stronger effect was observed (OR 2.86 (95% c.i. 1.80 to 4.53)). No significant differences were observed in anastomotic leakage, postoperative complications, reoperations, and readmissions. R-TME was associated with a lower conversion rate compared with L-TME (OR 0.37 (95% c.i. 0.28 to 0.49)).
CONCLUSION: R-TME is associated with a higher likelihood of primary anastomosis formation while maintaining a comparable safety profile. The more pronounced effect in recent studies likely reflects increasing surgical expertise. Future research should determine whether these advantages translate into measurable improvements in patient quality of life.

related.title_zh: 機器人輔助與腹腔鏡大腸切除術體內吻合之短期預後比較：單中心研究合併系統性回顧與統合分析

papers.title_zh: 機器人輔助與腹腔鏡全直腸系膜切除術（TME）中保留性（吻合）手術之比較：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：直腸癌的外科治療基於全直腸系膜切除術（TME）原則。由於其技術優勢，機器人輔助TME（R-TME）被假設比腹腔鏡TME（L-TME）更能促成初次吻合（保留性手術）。本系統性回顧與統合分析旨在探討R-TME是否與較高的保留性手術機率相關，相較於L-TME。方法：本研究依據PRISMA準則進行，計畫書已在PROSPERO國際前瞻性系統性回顧註冊登記（註冊號：1106767）。檢索PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Web of Science及Cochrane Library，納入2010年1月至2026年1月之研究。以隨機效應模型計算彙總勝算比（OR）及平均差異。結果：共納入20篇研究，涵蓋7133名病人。彙總分析顯示R-TME與較高之保留性手術機率顯著相關（OR 1.43，95%信賴區間1.04至1.98）。在2020年後病人的次群組分析中，觀察到更強的效應（OR 2.86，95%信賴區間1.80至4.53）。吻合口漏、術後併發症、再手術及再入院率均無顯著差異。R-TME與較低之轉開腹率相關，相較於L-TME（OR 0.37，95%信賴區間0.28至0.49）。結論：R-TME與較高之初次吻合形成機率相關，同時維持相當的安全性。近期研究中更顯著的效應可能反映手術經驗的累積。未來研究應確認這些優勢是否能轉化為病人生活品質的可測量改善。
papers.score_reason: 統合分析樣本量大（7133人）但納入多為非隨機觀察性研究，手術方式選擇可能受病人與腫瘤特徵影響（confounding by indication），因果性有限。
papers.relevance_why: 機器人與腹腔鏡TME的選擇及保留吻合可行性，是台灣大腸直腸外科日常臨床決策核心議題。
papers.one_liner: 在20篇研究、7133名直腸癌病人中，比較機器人與腹腔鏡TME，機器人保留吻合機率較高（OR 1.43）。
papers.action: 對低位直腸癌病人若評估適合機器人手術，可考慮其較高保留吻合潛力，但仍需個案評估及更高等級證據確認。

pico.P: 20篇研究，共7133名接受TME之直腸癌病人
pico.O: 主要：保留性手術（初次吻合）機率；次要：吻合口漏、術後併發症、再手術、再入院、轉開腹率

key_numbers: 保留性手術機率 R-TME優於L-TME：OR 1.43（95% CI 1.04-1.98）
轉開腹率 R-TME較低：OR 0.37（95% CI 0.28-0.49）；吻合口漏等安全性指標無顯著差異
cautions: 多為非隨機觀察性研究匯總，手術方式選擇可能受病人/腫瘤特徵影響，難排除選案偏差（confounding by indication）
全文僅提供OR，未見絕對事件數或發生率，無法計算ARR/NNT評估臨床意義大小
2020後次群組效應增強可能反映手術選擇趨勢或異質性變化，而非單純技術進步因果效應
unassessable: 納入研究設計比例（RCT vs 非RCT）
試驗註冊狀況（個別研究）
papers.context: 此篇延伸了先前對機器人與腹腔鏡在直腸/大腸手術短期結果比較的文獻線（如體內吻合比較、IPAA比較），但聚焦於一個新的、更上游的結果指標——「是否能保留吻合」本身的機率，而非吻合技術或既定吻合後的短期併發症。

papers.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis of preoperative MRI-based pelvimetry in predicting surgical difficulty in rectal cancer: Implications for personalised surgical planning
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Kitaguchi D, Kolbinger F, Dipanjyoti P, Jadhav K, Oda T, Forgione A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-based pelvimetry has been investigated for predicting surgical difficulty in total mesorectal excision (TME) for rectal cancer. However, heterogeneity in pelvimetric parameters, surrogate outcomes, and study design has resulted in inconsistent evidence. This systematic review aimed to synthesise the evidence on commonly used MRI parameters and difficulty surrogates and assess their methodological robustness and clinical relevance.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were systematically searched through December 2025 for studies evaluating preoperative MRI pelvimetry in patients undergoing TME for rectal cancer. Outcome parameters were surrogate measures of surgical difficulty, including operating time, intraoperative blood loss, conversion to open surgery, pathological quality metrics, and postoperative complications. Risk of bias was assessed using the Risk of Bias in Non-randomised Studies of Exposures (ROBINS-E) tool. This systematic review and meta-analysis was reported in accordance with the PRISMA 2020 statement and prospectively registered (PROSPERO: CRD420261287153).
RESULTS: Thirty-six studies comprising 8,364 patients were included. Common parameters included sagittal measurements and axial interspinous distance (ISD) and intertuberous distance (ITD). Definitions of surgical difficulty varied substantially. ROBINS-E identified some concerns in 30 studies, a high risk of bias in five, and insufficient information in one. Meta-analysis of six studies (n = 769) showed that shorter ISD (mean difference [MD] -5.13 mm, 95% CI -6.61 to -3.65; p < 0.001; I2 = 0%) and ITD (MD -7.32 mm, 95% CI -10.24 to -4.39; p = 0.004; I2 = 0%) were significantly associated with surrogate measures of surgical difficulty.
CONCLUSIONS: MRI-based pelvimetry, particularly ISD and ITD, may help predict surgical difficulty in TME. However, methodological heterogeneity limits broader quantitative synthesis and highlights the need for standardised pelvimetric protocols.

papers.title_zh: 術前MRI骨盆測量預測直腸癌手術困難度之系統性回顧與統合分析：個人化手術計畫之意義
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：以磁共振造影（MRI）為基礎的骨盆測量已被用於預測直腸癌全直腸系膜切除術（TME）之手術困難度。然而骨盆測量參數、手術困難度替代指標及研究設計之異質性，導致證據結果不一致。本系統性回顧旨在整合常用MRI參數與困難度替代指標之證據，並評估其方法學嚴謹性與臨床相關性。

方法：系統性檢索PubMed、Embase及Cochrane Library至2025年12月，納入評估接受TME直腸癌患者術前MRI骨盆測量之研究。結果參數為手術困難度之替代指標，包括手術時間、術中出血量、轉開腹手術、病理品質指標及術後併發症。偏誤風險採用ROBINS-E（非隨機暴露研究偏誤風險）工具評估。本系統性回顧與統合分析依PRISMA 2020聲明撰寫，並已於PROSPERO前瞻性註冊（註冊號：CRD420261287153）。

結果：共納入36篇研究，8,364名患者。常見參數包括矢狀面測量及軸切面之棘突間距（ISD）與坐骨結節間距（ITD）。手術困難度之定義差異甚大。ROBINS-E評估顯示30篇研究有一定程度之顧慮、5篇為高風險偏誤、1篇資訊不足。對6篇研究（n = 769）進行統合分析顯示，較短之ISD（平均差異[MD] -5.13 mm，95% CI -6.61至-3.65；p < 0.001；I2 = 0%）與ITD（MD -7.32 mm，95% CI -10.24至-4.39；p = 0.004；I2 = 0%）皆與手術困難度替代指標顯著相關。

結論：以MRI為基礎之骨盆測量，特別是ISD與ITD，可能有助於預測TME手術困難度。然而方法學異質性限制了更廣泛的量化整合，並凸顯標準化骨盆測量方案之必要性。
papers.score_reason: PROSPERO註冊、PRISMA規範完整，但實際統合僅6篇/769人，36篇中多數有偏誤顧慮，且「手術困難度」為異質性高之替代指標，臨床可直接應用性有限。
papers.relevance_why: 術前評估骨盆狹窄程度以預判TME困難度，是大腸直腸外科日常術前規劃會考慮的實務議題。
papers.one_liner: 統合36篇研究（8364人）評估MRI骨盆測量，其中6篇（769人）顯示較短ISD（MD -5.13mm）與ITD（MD -7.32mm）與手術困難度相關。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法：缺乏標準化困難度定義與具體cutoff值，無法直接轉化為術前分級或決定手術方式（如機器手臂vs腹腔鏡）之依據。

pico.P: 接受TME之直腸癌患者，36篇研究共8364人（統合分析僅6篇研究769人）
pico.I: 術前MRI骨盆測量參數，主要為棘突間距（ISD）與坐骨結節間距（ITD）
pico.C: 骨盆測量值較大者 vs 較小者（以手術困難與否分組比較）
pico.O: 主要：手術困難度替代指標（手術時間、出血量、轉開腹率、病理品質、併發症）；次要：方法學品質（ROBINS-E）

key_numbers: 6篇研究(769人)統合：ISD在困難組較短 MD -5.13mm(95% CI -6.61至-3.65, p<0.001)
同一統合：ITD在困難組較短 MD -7.32mm(95% CI -10.24至-4.39, p=0.004)
36篇研究中僅6篇(17%)可納入定量統合，30篇有偏誤顧慮、5篇高風險偏誤
cautions: 「手術困難度」為異質性極高之替代指標，各研究定義不同，非真實臨床終點如滲漏率、長期功能
僅6/36篇研究可納入統合分析，納入標準與排除原因摘要未說明，可能有選擇性偏誤
MD為骨盆測量毫米差異，無具體cutoff值可供臨床分級或決策使用，實證轉譯仍早期
unassessable: 個別原始研究之失訪率、ITT分析、利益衝突
統合分析使用之隨機/固定效應模型選擇細節
是否進行發表偏誤評估（funnel plot、Egger's test）
papers.context: 無相關前作。先前看過的論文為MRI放射組學預測pCR/基因突變、及機器人vs腹腔鏡TME比較，均與本篇「MRI骨盆測量預測手術困難度」之臨床問題不同，無直接關聯。

papers.title: The Acceptability and Experiences of Participating in a Preoperative Intentional Weight-Loss Programme From Diagnosis to Surgery for Colorectal Cancer
papers.journal_full: Health expectations : an international journal of public participation in health care and health policy
papers.authors: Talbot A, Foster C, Jebb S, Wheatstone P, Buczacki S, Koutoukidis D
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Colorectal cancer surgery has a higher risk of complications for patients carrying excess weight. Preoperative weight loss might reduce this risk. However, it is unclear how patients perceive engagement with an intensive weight-loss programme in the short window between diagnosis and surgery. This qualitative study, embedded within the CARE randomised controlled trial, aimed to understand the acceptability and experiences of following an intensive weight-loss programme with dietetic support as prehabilitation before colorectal cancer surgery.
METHODS: Thirty-one participants (65% male, mean (SD) BMI 36.0 (5.5) kg/m2, 65 (7) years) took part in a semi-structured interview based on the Theoretical Framework of Acceptability after following the programme for an average of 24 (12) days and 12 (7) days before surgery. Data were thematically analysed using the four constructs of Normalisation Process Theory (NPT).
RESULTS: Participants understood, via interactions with healthcare professionals, that the programme could potentially make their operation technically easier and expedite hospital discharge (coherence). Continued adherence was supported by the dietitians (cognitive participation), and improvements in health markers and rapid weight loss helped to reframe some participants' views that their bodies were failing due to cancer (reflexive monitoring). However, some families' distrust of the programme's safety, social eating occasions, and side effects prevented full acceptability and total adherence (collective action). This highlighted how collective action sometimes overrode the consistently strong coherence, cognitive participation, and reflexive monitoring components of NPT.
CONCLUSION: The weight-loss programme was mostly acceptable to people who had already joined the intervention. Addressing challenges with collective action may support more patients to adhere.
CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRATION: ISRCTN39207707, Registration date 13/03/2023.
papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌病人參與術前「刻意減重」介入計畫（診斷至手術期間）之可接受度與經驗：質性研究
papers.abstract_zh:
前言：對於體重過重的病人，大腸直腸癌手術併發症風險較高。術前減重或可降低此風險。然而，病人在診斷至手術之間的短暫時間窗內，如何看待參與高強度減重計畫，目前尚不清楚。本質性研究嵌入於 CARE 隨機對照試驗中，旨在了解病人在大腸直腸癌手術前接受包含營養師支持的高強度減重復能（prehabilitation）計畫的可接受度與經驗。

方法：31 名參與者（65% 男性，平均（標準差）BMI 36.0（5.5）kg/m²，年齡 65（7）歲）在平均執行計畫 24（12）天、術前 12（7）天時，依據「可接受度理論架構」接受半結構式訪談。資料以常規化過程理論（NPT）的四個構面進行主題分析。

結果：參與者透過與醫療人員的互動了解到，此計畫可能使手術技術上更容易進行並加速出院（一致性 coherence）。營養師的支持有助於維持持續遵從（認知參與 cognitive participation）；健康指標改善與快速減重則協助部分參與者重新框架其「身體因癌症而衰敗」的看法（反思性監測 reflexive monitoring）。然而，部分家庭對計畫安全性的不信任、社交聚餐場合與副作用，妨礙了完全的可接受度與完全遵從（集體行動 collective action）。此結果突顯集體行動有時會凌駕於一致性強烈的一致性、認知參與與反思性監測構面之上。

結論：對於已加入介入組的參與者而言，此減重計畫大多具可接受度。處理集體行動方面的挑戰，可能有助於更多病人遵從計畫。

臨床試驗註冊：ISRCTN39207707，註冊日期 2023/03/13。
papers.score_reason: 此為嵌入RCT的質性研究，樣本小（n=31）且僅訪談已加入計畫者，對臨床決策無直接效益數據，但對設計台灣prehab計畫的溝通策略有參考價值。
papers.relevance_why: 探討術前減重prehabilitation的病人接受度與遵從障礙，與大腸直腸外科日益重視的術前優化策略相關，但非直接手術結果數據。
papers.one_liner: 在31名接受術前減重prehab計畫的大腸直腸癌病人中，質性訪談發現多數覺得可接受，但家庭疑慮與社交飲食阻礙完全遵從。
papers.action: 若規劃院內術前減重prehab計畫，可納入家屬衛教與處理社交飲食情境以提升遵從度；目前無法據此改變手術適應症或術式選擇。

papers.title: Preoperative Prediction of Lymph Node Metastasis in Colorectal Cancer Using Routinely Collected Clinical Data: Multicenter Retrospective Machine Learning Model Development and External Validation Study
papers.authors: Xu G, Sun X, Jiang J, Sun J, Li L, Cheng H
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Preoperative nodal assessment in colorectal cancer (CRC) remains imperfect, and uncertainty regarding pathological lymph node metastasis (LNM) may persist despite conventional imaging. Machine learning using routinely available preoperative information may provide complementary patient-level risk estimates without requiring radiomic feature extraction or molecular testing.
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to develop and externally validate machine learning models for preoperative estimation of pathologically confirmed LNM risk in patients with newly diagnosed CRC undergoing direct radical surgery without preoperative anticancer treatment, and to assess whether multivariable prediction adds information beyond clinical tumor stage (cT) alone.
METHODS: This multicenter retrospective study included 2725 patients from 2 hospitals. The internal cohort (n=1074) was split into training (n=753) and internal test (n=321) sets, while 1651 patients from a second center formed the external validation cohort. Candidate predictors were routinely available preoperative clinical, laboratory, tumor-marker, imaging-based, and endoscopic biopsy variables. Predictors were selected using univariable and multivariable logistic regression (LR). Seven algorithms were evaluated: random forest (RF), support vector machine (SVM), LR, decision tree (DT), extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost), naive Bayes (NB), and light gradient boosting machine (LightGBM). Performance was assessed using discrimination, threshold-dependent classification metrics, calibration, and decision curve analysis (DCA). Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) were used for interpretation. Sensitivity analyses compared the selected predictors with all candidate predictors and cT alone.
RESULTS: Six predictors were retained: BMI, preoperative carcinoembryonic antigen, primary tumor site, cT, histological type, and tumor differentiation. RF was selected based on internal test performance. The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.803 (95% CI 0.756-0.849) in the internal test set and 0.776 (95% CI 0.755-0.797) in external validation. In external validation, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) were 0.687, 0.677, 0.693, 0.569, and 0.781, respectively. The Brier score was 0.190, and the calibration slope was 1.061. cT contributed most in SHAP analysis; however, the 6-predictor RF model showed significantly higher discrimination than cT alone in both the internal test set (AUROC 0.803 vs 0.712; ΔAUROC=0.091; P<.001) and external validation cohort (AUROC 0.776 vs 0.707; ΔAUROC=0.069; P<.001). Discrimination did not differ significantly between the 6-predictor and all-predictor RF models.
CONCLUSIONS: We developed and externally validated a 6-predictor RF model for preoperative LNM risk estimation in patients with newly diagnosed CRC undergoing radical resection with regional lymph node dissection without preoperative anticancer treatment. The model showed moderate external discrimination and provided predictive information beyond cT alone. It is intended for research-stage adjunctive risk stratification and should not replace imaging, pathological evaluation, or clinical judgment. Prospective validation in broader populations and clinical settings is required before implementation.

papers.title_zh: 使用常規收集之臨床資料預測大腸直腸癌術前淋巴結轉移：多中心回溯性機器學習模型建立與外部驗證研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：大腸直腸癌（CRC）術前淋巴結評估仍不完美，儘管有傳統影像檢查，病理淋巴結轉移（LNM）的不確定性仍然存在。使用常規可取得的術前資訊進行機器學習，可能提供補充性的病人層級風險估計，且不需進行放射組學特徵提取或分子檢測。

目的：本研究旨在建立並外部驗證機器學習模型，用於術前估計新診斷CRC病人（接受直接根治性手術、未接受術前抗癌治療）病理確診LNM風險，並評估多變項預測是否能提供超越臨床腫瘤分期（cT）單獨使用之額外資訊。

方法：此多中心回溯性研究納入來自2家醫院的2725名病人。內部世代（n=1074）分為訓練組（n=753）與內部測試組（n=321），另有來自第二中心的1651名病人組成外部驗證世代。候選預測因子包括常規可取得的術前臨床、檢驗、腫瘤標記、影像學及內視鏡切片變項。預測因子以單變項及多變項邏輯回歸（LR）篩選。評估七種演算法：隨機森林（RF）、支持向量機（SVM）、LR、決策樹（DT）、極限梯度提升（XGBoost）、單純貝氏（NB）、光梯度提升機（LightGBM）。以辨別力、閾值依賴分類指標、校正度及決策曲線分析（DCA）評估表現。使用Shapley加成解釋（SHAP）進行結果詮釋。敏感度分析比較所選預測因子、全部候選預測因子與cT單獨使用之差異。

結果：最終保留六項預測因子：BMI、術前癌胚抗原、原發腫瘤部位、cT、組織學類型及腫瘤分化程度。根據內部測試表現選定RF模型。內部測試組的曲線下面積（AUROC）為0.803（95% CI 0.756-0.849），外部驗證組為0.776（95% CI 0.755-0.797）。外部驗證中，準確度、敏感度、特異度、陽性預測值（PPV）及陰性預測值（NPV）分別為0.687、0.677、0.693、0.569及0.781。Brier分數為0.190，校正斜率為1.061。SHAP分析顯示cT貢獻度最大；然而，6項預測因子RF模型在內部測試組（AUROC 0.803 vs 0.712；ΔAUROC=0.091；P<.001）及外部驗證世代（AUROC 0.776 vs 0.707；ΔAUROC=0.069；P<.001）均顯示顯著優於cT單獨使用之辨別力。6項預測因子模型與全部預測因子RF模型之辨別力無顯著差異。

結論：我們建立並外部驗證了一個6項預測因子RF模型，用於新診斷CRC病人（接受含區域淋巴結廓清之根治性切除手術、未接受術前抗癌治療）之術前LNM風險估計。該模型顯示中等的外部辨別力，並提供超越cT單獨使用之預測資訊。此模型目前僅適用於研究階段之輔助性風險分層，不應取代影像學、病理評估或臨床判斷。在更廣泛族群及臨床情境中進行前瞻性驗證，方能考慮實際應用。

papers.title: Clinical and pathological characteristics of mucinous adenocarcinoma in colon cancer: comparison with classic adenocarcinoma
papers.authors: Acar B, Muhtaroğlu A, Kesi̇ci̇oğlu T, Acar S, Yilmaz E, Çeki̇ç Y
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Mucinous adenocarcinoma of the colon is defined by extracellular mucin occupying at least 50% of the tumour. Although it is often regarded as a distinct histological subtype, its clinicopathological profile remains variable across published series. We compared mucinous and classic adenocarcinoma in a colon-only surgical cohort.
METHODS: We retrospectively reviewed patients who underwent oncological resection for colon adenocarcinoma between October 2021 and March 2026. Rectal tumours, neoadjuvant-treated cases and signet ring cell carcinoma were excluded. Clinicopathological variables were compared using Mann-Whitney U, Pearson chi-square or Fisher exact tests. Multivariable analyses were revised as parsimonious logistic regression models, with model size and event counts reported.
RESULTS: The final cohort included 155 colon cancers: 29 mucinous and 126 classic adenocarcinomas. Mucinous tumours were more often right-sided (75.9% vs. 44.4%; p = 0.002) and more frequently poorly differentiated (24.1% vs. 4.8%; p = 0.003). Advanced pT stage was common in both groups (86.2% vs. 82.5%; p = 0.786). Nodal metastasis was numerically less frequent in mucinous adenocarcinoma (31.0% vs. 50.8%; p = 0.055), while lymphovascular invasion was significantly less common (10.3% vs. 32.5%; p = 0.017). Deficient mismatch repair was recorded in 13.8% of mucinous tumours and 8.7% of classic adenocarcinomas (p = 0.484). In parsimonious adjusted models, mucinous histology was not independently associated with advanced pT stage (adjusted OR 1.51, 95% CI 0.46-4.92; p = 0.496) or nodal metastasis (adjusted OR 0.48, 95% CI 0.19-1.19; p = 0.113).
CONCLUSIONS: In this colon-only cohort, mucinous adenocarcinoma was associated with right-sided location and poor differentiation, but not with independently higher local invasion or nodal spread. These findings support a cautious, clinicopathology-based interpretation of mucinous histology and should not be extrapolated to prognosis without molecular and survival data.

papers.title_zh: 大腸癌中黏液腺癌之臨床病理特徵：與傳統腺癌之比較
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：大腸黏液腺癌定義為腫瘤內細胞外黏液佔比至少50%。雖常被視為獨立組織學亞型，但其臨床病理特徵在不同文獻系列中仍有差異。本研究於單純大腸癌手術世代中比較黏液腺癌與傳統腺癌。
方法：回溯性回顧2021年10月至2026年3月間接受腫瘤性切除之大腸腺癌病人。排除直腸腫瘤、接受新輔助治療者及印戒細胞癌。臨床病理變項以Mann-Whitney U檢定、Pearson卡方檢定或Fisher精確檢定比較。多變量分析以精簡邏輯迴歸模型呈現，並報告模型大小與事件數。
結果：最終世代納入155例大腸癌：29例黏液腺癌、126例傳統腺癌。黏液腺癌較常見於右側大腸（75.9% vs. 44.4%；p=0.002），且較常見分化不良（24.1% vs. 4.8%；p=0.003）。兩組進展期pT分期均常見（86.2% vs. 82.5%；p=0.786）。黏液腺癌之淋巴結轉移數值上較少（31.0% vs. 50.8%；p=0.055），而淋巴血管侵犯顯著較少（10.3% vs. 32.5%；p=0.017）。錯配修復缺失於黏液腺癌佔13.8%、傳統腺癌佔8.7%（p=0.484）。在精簡校正模型中，黏液組織學與進展期pT分期無獨立相關（校正後OR 1.51，95% CI 0.46-4.92；p=0.496），與淋巴結轉移亦無獨立相關（校正後OR 0.48，95% CI 0.19-1.19；p=0.113）。
結論：在此單純大腸癌世代中，黏液腺癌與右側位置及分化不良相關，但與較高之局部侵犯或淋巴結擴散並無獨立相關。此結果支持對黏液組織學採取謹慎、以臨床病理為基礎之解讀，不應在缺乏分子與存活資料下外推至預後判斷。

papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Robotic-assisted surgery (RAS) for rectal cancer is increasingly adopted. However, a recent systematic review highlighted a significant gap in the literature regarding quality of life (QOL) after different total mesorectal excision (TME) techniques, with open TME being particularly underrepresented. This study aimed to compare QOL and anorectal function between robotic-assisted and open low anterior rectal resection with TME.
METHODS: Patients who underwent low anterior rectal resection with TME and primary anastomosis between 2006 and 2021 at a single tertiary centre were identified. Propensity score matching was performed based on sex, age, BMI, UICC stage and tumour height. After excluding patients without QOL follow-up or with a persistent diverting stoma, 40 patients per group were available. QOL was assessed using the EORTC QLQ-C30, QLQ-CR29, and LARS score.
RESULTS: In the matched cohort, baseline characteristics were well balanced except for tumour height (p = .002), with more lower-third tumours in the open group. No significant differences were observed in any EORTC QLQ-C30 domain, including global health status (66.5 vs. 71.7, p = .197). QLQ-CR29 showed comparable outcomes for most domains; however, sexual interest was significantly lower in the RAS group for women (88.1 vs. 55.6, p = .008). LARS scores were similar between groups (24.4 vs. 25.6, p = .765). Perioperative outcomes including morbidity (10.0% vs. 22.5%, p = .130) and anastomotic leakage (2.5% vs. 5.0%, p = .526) did not differ significantly.
CONCLUSIONS: Robotic-assisted and open low anterior rectal resection with TME resulted in comparable QOL and anorectal function across all assessed domains. Notably, approximately one third of patients in both groups reported major LARS, underscoring the persistent functional burden irrespective of surgical approach. By providing direct comparative data on open TME - an approach underrepresented in the literature - these findings contribute to closing an important evidence gap.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：直腸癌機器手臂輔助手術（RAS）的應用日益增加。然而近期一篇系統性回顧指出，文獻中關於不同全直腸繫膜切除術（TME）術式後生活品質（QOL）的比較存在重大缺口，尤其開腹TME的資料特別不足。本研究旨在比較機器手臂輔助與開腹低位前位直腸切除合併TME術後的生活品質與肛門直腸功能。方法：納入2006年至2021年間於單一三級醫學中心接受低位前位直腸切除合併TME及一期吻合的病人。依性別、年齡、BMI、UICC分期及腫瘤高度進行傾向分數配對。排除無QOL追蹤資料或持續性造口病人後，每組各有40名病人可供分析。QOL以EORTC QLQ-C30、QLQ-CR29及LARS評分評估。結果：配對後世代之基線特徵大致平衡，惟腫瘤高度有差異（p=.002），開腹組中下三分之一腫瘤較多。EORTC QLQ-C30各領域均無顯著差異，包括整體健康狀態（66.5 vs. 71.7，p=.197）。QLQ-CR29多數領域結果相近；然而女性RAS組的性興趣顯著較低（88.1 vs. 55.6，p=.008）。LARS評分兩組相近（24.4 vs. 25.6，p=.765）。圍手術期結果包括併發症發生率（10.0% vs. 22.5%，p=.130）及吻合口瘻管（2.5% vs. 5.0%，p=.526）均無顯著差異。結論：機器手臂輔助與開腹低位前位直腸切除合併TME在所有評估領域的QOL與肛門直腸功能結果相當。值得注意的是，兩組約三分之一病人回報重度LARS，顯示無論手術方式，功能負擔持續存在。本研究提供了文獻中較為缺乏的開腹TME直接比較資料，有助於填補此重要的證據缺口。

papers.title: Divergent immune ecosystems in HPV-associated and HPV-independent lower anogenital tract malignancies
papers.authors: Wang H, Sun Z, Zhang Y, Zhu H
papers.abstract: Lower anogenital tract malignancies comprise anatomically adjacent but biologically heterogeneous epithelial cancers of the cervix, vulva, vagina, anal canal and penis. This narrative and conceptual Review used a transparent literature search to examine how human papillomavirus (HPV) etiology intersects with tumor lineage, somatic alterations, antigen-presentation competence, immune-cell state and spatial organization. Evidence quality is heterogeneous: cervical cancer is supported by the largest genomic, single-cell, spatial and randomized-trial literature, whereas vaginal, vulvar and penile cancers remain constrained by small retrospective cohorts and cross-site extrapolation. HPV-associated tumors retain non-self E6/E7 antigens, but viral transcription does not ensure peptide presentation, dendritic-cell priming or epithelial access by functional T cells. HPV-independent tumors lack constitutive viral antigens yet may generate mutation- or differentiation-derived immunity and checkpoint-restrained myeloid-lymphoid niches. We therefore distinguish etiological status from functional immune phenotype and critically appraise three spatial architectures-an inflamed/epithelial-penetrating pattern, a stromally excluded pattern, and an immune-desert pattern-together with an immunosuppressive functional overlay that may occur in any architecture. Clinical evidence is graded separately from mechanistic inference: immune checkpoint blockade has established roles in defined cervical and anal cancer settings, whereas therapeutic vaccines, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, T-cell receptor-engineered therapies, myeloid or stromal sensitization and artificial-intelligence-guided selection remain investigational or context dependent. A three-tier biomarker framework is proposed, separating routine clinical assays from extended translational profiling and exploratory single-cell, spatial and artificial-intelligence methods. This framework is hypothesis-generating, not a validated treatment-selection algorithm; assay combinations, thresholds and incremental clinical utility require prospective, multicenter and site-stratified validation.

papers.abstract_zh: 下肛門生殖道惡性腫瘤包含解剖位置相鄰但生物學上異質的上皮癌，涵蓋子宮頸、外陰、陰道、肛管與陰莖。本敘述性及概念性綜述採用透明化文獻搜尋方法，探討人類乳突病毒（HPV）病因學如何與腫瘤譜系、體細胞變異、抗原呈現能力、免疫細胞狀態及空間組織相互交織。證據品質具高度異質性：子宮頸癌有最大規模的基因體學、單細胞、空間及隨機對照試驗文獻支持，而陰道、外陰及陰莖癌則受限於小型回溯性世代研究及跨部位外推。HPV相關腫瘤保留非自身E6/E7抗原，但病毒轉錄並不保證胜肽呈現、樹突細胞致敏或功能性T細胞的上皮進入。HPV非依賴性腫瘤缺乏組成性病毒抗原，但可能產生突變或分化衍生之免疫反應，以及受免疫檢查點抑制之骨髓-淋巴系微環境。因此我們區分病因學狀態與功能性免疫表型，並批判性評估三種空間架構——發炎性/上皮浸潤型、間質排除型、免疫沙漠型——及可能發生於任何架構中的免疫抑制性功能疊加。臨床證據與機制推論分別分級：免疫檢查點阻斷在特定子宮頸癌及肛門癌情境中已具確立角色，而治療性疫苗、腫瘤浸潤淋巴細胞、T細胞受體工程化療法、骨髓或間質致敏及人工智慧輔助篩選仍屬研究性或情境依賴。本文提出三層級生物標記框架，區分常規臨床檢測、延伸轉譯分析及探索性單細胞、空間與人工智慧方法。此框架為假說生成性質，並非經驗證的治療選擇演算法；檢測組合、閾值及臨床實用增益均需前瞻性、多中心及分層驗證。

papers.title: Mitochondrial dysfunction as a metabolic checkpoint of immunotherapy response in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Tomassini L, Colella M, Monteleone G, Stolfi C, Laudisi F
papers.abstract: Immunotherapy has markedly improved outcomes across multiple cancer types; however, colorectal cancer (CRC) remains largely refractory, with meaningful responses mostly restricted to tumors harboring deficient mismatch repair and high microsatellite instability (dMMR/MSI-H), which represent only a small fraction of CRC cases. Emerging evidence suggests that mitochondrial dysfunction may be viewed as a metabolic checkpoint, representing a conceptual framework through which mitochondrial-dependent processes regulate antitumor immunity and immunotherapy response in CRC. In tumor cells, mitochondrial reprogramming enhances reliance on oxidative phosphorylation, promotes hypoxia, and drives metabolite accumulation, collectively shaping an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. In parallel, tumor-infiltrating T-cells exhibit mitochondrial dysfunction characterized by impaired biogenesis, reduced respiratory capacity and features of exhaustion, thereby limiting the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). In this review, we summarize current insights into the role of mitochondrial pathways in regulating tumor immune escape and T-cell dysfunction in CRC. We further discuss emerging therapeutic strategies aimed at targeting metabolic vulnerabilities to overcome resistance and potentially enhance responses to immunotherapy.

papers.title_zh: 線粒體功能障礙作為大腸直腸癌免疫治療反應的代謝檢查點
papers.abstract_zh: 免疫治療已顯著改善多種癌症的預後；然而大腸直腸癌（CRC）大多仍對其具抗性，有意義的治療反應主要侵限於帶有錯配修復缺陷與高度微衛星不穩定性（dMMR/MSI-H）的腫瘤，而此類腫瘤僅占CRC病例的一小部分。新興證據顯示，線粒體功能障礙可被視為一種代謝檢查點，提供一個概念框架，說明線粒體依賴性過程如何調控CRC中的抗腫瘤免疫與免疫治療反應。在腫瘤細胞中，線粒體重新編程增強其對氧化磷酸化的依賴，促進缺氧，並驅動代謝物累積，共同塑造出免疫抑制性的腫瘤微環境。同時，腫瘤浸潤T細胞表現出線粒體功能障礙，特徵為生合成受損、呼吸能力降低以及耗竭特徵，從而限制免疫檢查點抑制劑（ICIs）的療效。在這篇綜述中，我們總結了目前對線粒體路徑在調控CRC腫瘤免疫逃逸與T細胞功能障礙中角色的理解。我們進一步討論了旨在針對代謝脆弱性以克服抗藥性、並可能增強免疫治療反應的新興治療策略。

papers.title: The shifting balance: innate lymphoid cell plasticity in chronic gut diseases
papers.authors: Ling P, Fang J, Wang J, Xu Y, Huang N, Mu R
papers.abstract: Innate lymphoid cells (ILCs), as core components of innate immunity, coordinate mucosal immune defense and homeostasis through their functional plasticity. They exhibit functional diversity in the intestine and display a complex dual role in intestinal diseases, which is closely associated with their phenotypic transformation and functional reprogramming. Current studies have demonstrated that ILCs play critical roles in various chronic intestinal diseases, including autoimmune intestinal disorders, chronic infectious intestinal inflammation, and colorectal cancer. However, the specific functions and reprogramming mechanisms of ILC subsets remain controversial across different types of intestinal diseases. This review provides a comprehensive overview of current research on the mechanisms of ILCs in chronic intestinal diseases, aiming to advance the development of immunotherapeutic strategies targeting ILC reprogramming and offer novel insights into the prevention and treatment of intestinal diseases.

papers.title: Tripartite Interplay of Epithelial, Immune, and Microbiota Dysregulation in Crohn's Disease: Mechanisms and Translational Strategies
papers.authors: Lai Q, Zhang Q, Yang W, Luo C
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Crohn's disease (CD) is a multifactorial inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) characterized by impaired epithelial barrier integrity, excessive immune hyperactivation, and gut microbiota perturbations. Cumulative evidence supports the role of the intestinal epithelial barrier, immune system and gut microbiota in the progression of CD.
OBJECTIVE: This review constructs a mechanistic framework of the epithelial-immune-microbiota tripartite network in CD with a focus on positive‑feedback circuits sustaining persistent intestinal inflammation.
KEY FINDINGS: Interrelated pathological loops involving barrier injury, immune activation and microbial dysbiosis perpetuate chronic intestinal inflammation and provide a rationale for mechanism‑guided combinatorial therapeutic interventions.
CONCLUSIONS: This framework illuminates key pathogenic crosstalk that may be targeted to optimize future treatment regimens for CD.

papers.title: Conclusions and Therapeutic Implications of AA
papers.journal_full: Reviews of physiology, biochemistry and pharmacology
papers.abstract: AA is essential for several tissues in the body, as they are involved in many physiological and pathological processes. Its regulatory role in inflammation, immune response regulation, cell cycle, and membrane structural organization and its ability to control the expression and function(s) of several receptors and convey messages to and from the nucleus are of particular significance. Fine-tuning the metabolism of AA may lead to the development of prevention and management strategies for several diseases, including but not limited to sepsis, inflammatory bowel disease, diabetes mellitus, cancer, coronary heart disease, atherosclerosis, MASLD (NAFLD), hypertension, metabolic syndrome, uveitis, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, glomerulonephritis, ischemia-reperfusion injury, lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, and drug-resistant infections and cancer. AA is needed for normal brain growth and development, pregnancy, regeneration of the liver and heart, and hematopoiesis. AA can be administered orally, parenterally as needed, and as lipid nanoparticles to target specific tissues.

papers.title: Engineering Nanomaterial Platform for Inflammatory Bowel Disease: Three-Dimensional Integration of Delivery Mechanism, Therapeutic Drug Delivery and Intelligent Material Design
papers.authors: Qian J, Shen S, Chen S, Zhang H, Liu L, Zhou D
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a chronic intestinal inflammatory disorder with a complex etiology and a high recurrence rate. Conventional treatments face significant limitations in targeting, stability, and efficacy. Going beyond conventional reviews that focus on isolated mechanisms, this review offers a systematic integration of three engineering perspectives: how to deliver (targeting mechanisms), what to deliver (pathology-based therapeutic payloads), and what to use for delivery (smart material design). We highlight emerging nanoplatforms-including nanozymes, probiotic-based nano-delivery systems, and stimuli-responsive nano-delivery systems-that address oxidative stress and gut dysbiosis, two core pathologies of IBD. We also discuss novel approaches for delivering nanodrugs to target cells and advocate for the use of hybrid synthetic/natural materials to achieve a balance between efficacy and safety of nanomaterials. However, a critical gap that must be confronted is that the vast majority of existing studies remain confined to acute, chemically induced colitis models (typically 7-14 days), which poorly recapitulate the chronic, relapsing nature of human IBD. Systematic validation of long-term safety and efficacy including biodistribution, metabolic clearance, and chronic toxicity profiles over extended periods is urgently needed before any meaningful clinical translation can be contemplated. This recognition of the acute-to-chronic translation gap constitutes a central critical stance of this review. This is not merely a methodological concern but a fundamental barrier that pervades the entire field: the disconnect between acute model readouts and chronic disease outcomes has systematically inflated translational expectations while masking the true challenges of long-term efficacy, safety, and durability. Addressing this gap requires not only acknowledging its existence but also implementing concrete, standardized protocols for chronic model evaluation. Multidisciplinary collaboration is urgently needed to accelerate clinical translation.
papers.title_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病之奈米材料平台工程：遞送機制、治療藥物傳遞與智能材料設計之三維整合
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）是一種病因複雜、復發率高的慢性腸道發炎疾病。傳統治療在標靶性、穩定性與療效上面臨重大限制。本綜述超越僅聚焦單一機制的傳統回顧方式，系統性整合三個工程面向：如何遞送（標靶機制）、要遞送什麼（基於病理學的治療載荷），以及用什麼來遞送（智能材料設計）。我們重點介紹新興奈米平台——包括奈米酶、益生菌基奈米遞送系統、以及刺激反應型奈米遞送系統——這些平台針對IBD的兩個核心病理：氧化壓力與腸道菌叢失衡。我們也討論將奈米藥物遞送至目標細胞的新方法，並主張使用合成/天然混合材料，以在奈米材料的療效與安全性之間取得平衡。然而，必須正視的一個關鍵缺口是：絕大多數現有研究仍侷限於急性、化學誘發的結腸炎動物模型（通常為7-14天），無法充分重現人類IBD的慢性、反覆發作特性。在任何有意義的臨床轉譯之前，亟需系統性驗證長期安全性與療效，包括生物分布、代謝清除與長期毒性特徵。對此急性轉慢性轉譯缺口的認知，構成本綜述的核心批判立場。這不僅是方法學上的疑慮，更是貫穿整個領域的根本性障礙：急性模型讀數與慢性疾病結果之間的脫節，系統性地誇大了轉譯預期，同時掩蓋了長期療效、安全性與持久性的真正挑戰。彌補此缺口不僅需要承認其存在，更需要實施具體、標準化的慢性模型評估方案。亟需跨領域合作以加速臨床轉譯。

papers.title: Indole Hybrids: Emerging EGFR-Targeted Agents With Multifaceted Anticancer Properties (2021-Present)
papers.authors: Zhang B, Wang Y, Wen S, Liu Z, Zhao B, Dai L
papers.abstract: The epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) is a validated therapeutic target for EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and colorectal cancer, yet secondary T790M/C797S mutations and mesenchymal-epithelial transition factor (MET) amplification confer profound resistance to first-, second-, and third-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs). Indole hybrids integrate indole cores (including azaindoles and fused indoles) with diverse pharmacophores to achieve multi-site binding within the EGFR ATP pocket, conferring higher selectivity toward mutant EGFR than mono-indole scaffolds. This review systematically summarizes indole-based EGFR hybrids reported from 2021 to date into three categories: Phase I/II clinical candidates (1, 10), C797S-resistant preclinical leads (11a, 14a, 34, 48a, and 50a), and structurally diversified analogs with favorable blood-brain barrier (BBB) permeability and low systemic toxicity. Optimized indole hybrids exhibit prominent advantages over commercial TKIs, including enhanced binding affinity toward mutant EGFR, optimized pharmacokinetic profiles, minimized off-target effects, and the capacity to suppress compensatory oncogenic signals. We comprehensively dissect their binding modes, structure-activity relationships (SARs), in vitro/in vivo anticancer activities, and pharmacological features, and summarize critical substituent optimization rules for overcoming resistance. This work establishes a systematic structural basis for rational development of next-generation indole EGFR inhibitors against refractory EGFR-driven malignancies.

papers.title_zh: 吲哚雜合物：新興EGFR標靶藥物之多面向抗癌特性研究 (2021年迄今)
papers.abstract_zh: 表皮生長因子受體（EGFR）是EGFR突變型非小細胞肺癌（NSCLC）與大腸直腸癌之公認治療標靶，然而次發性T790M/C797S突變與間質上皮轉化因子（MET）擴增對第一、二、三代EGFR酪胺酸激酶抑制劑（TKIs）產生顯著抗藥性。吲哚雜合物將吲哚核心（包括氮雜吲哚與稠合吲哚）與多種藥效基團結合，以達成EGFR ATP口袋內多位點結合，相較單一吲哚骨架對突變型EGFR具有更高選擇性。本綜述系統性整理2021年至今發表之吲哚類EGFR雜合物，分為三類：第I/II期臨床候選藥物（化合物1、10）、抗C797S之臨床前先導化合物（11a、14a、34、48a、50a），以及具良好血腦屏障（BBB）穿透性與低全身毒性之結構多樣化類似物。經最佳化之吲哚雜合物相較市售TKIs展現顯著優勢，包括對突變型EGFR之結合親和力提升、藥物動力學特性優化、脫靶效應最小化，以及抑制代償性致癌訊號之能力。本文全面剖析其結合模式、構效關係（SARs）、體外/體內抗癌活性及藥理特性，並總結克服抗藥性之關鍵取代基優化規則。此研究為難治性EGFR驅動惡性腫瘤之下一代吲哚類EGFR抑制劑理性開發建立系統性結構基礎。
